en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a street scene with an early electric tram car numbered 6 stopped on tracks. A crowd of men, women, and children in early 20th‑century clothing stand on both sides of the tram, some in uniforms. Another tram is partly visible on the right. On the left is a low building with a sign bearing the name 'Franz Godinger'. Over the street hangs a large flag with horizontal stripes, and the tram is decorated, suggesting an inauguration or celebration of a tram line.
